facility_desc: Foundation Park North, site of Amazon FSD1 fulfillment center (80 ac bought Oct 2020 for $7.02M; Foundation Park Ryan Cos build) and 2025-26 last-mile site
program: Tax Increment Finance District #23 (Foundation Park North), 540 acres, project plan Jan 2021
issuer: City of Sioux Falls (TIF recipient and developer: Sioux Falls Development Foundation, a nonprofit, not Amazon)
notes: Project plan states TIF-eligible costs $132,747,836 incl. $30,000,000 economic development competitiveness fund; TIF requested $94,371,313 plus financing costs; 20-year term requested (SiouxFalls.Business 2021-01-26). Money pays roads, water and sewer for the park; Amazon is one of the tenants. Foundation CEO Mundt (Dakota News Now 2021-03-03): 'Amazon gave us the ability to collect some increment' to start the infrastructure. Council designated TIF 23 boundaries 2020-09-15 (KELO 2020-09-17: 539.25 acres, TIF 23, no Amazon confirmation then); council approved the plan about 2021-03-02 (Argus Leader headline 'approves plan investing nearly $100 million', body paywalled). Area-wide infrastructure subsidy: not a payment to Amazon, and the projected increment includes CJ Foods. Do not add to the Amazon-specific totals without this caveat.

facility_desc: Foundation Park infrastructure; Amazon named as beneficiary in the grant application (1,000 jobs, $200M private investment)
program: US EDA CARES Act Recovery Assistance grant to Sioux Falls Development Foundation
issuer: US Department of Commerce, Economic Development Administration (federal)
notes: FEDERAL grant, matched with $478,830 local funds (SDPB 2020-09-30; same text in Sioux Falls Development Foundation release 2020-10-15 in raw/subsidies/SD). The EDA release itself (eda.gov archive) returned a maintenance page and the USAspending page saved as an empty shell, so the amount rests on SDPB, which says the Commerce announcement did not name Amazon; the grant application (obtained by the Argus Leader) names Amazon as a beneficiary. financial.md excludes federal grants from the state-subsidy totals: keep this row out of sums. Goes to the Foundation, not to Amazon.
